pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi kāfēi.
en: I would like a cup of coffee.

pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi kāfēi.
en: I would like a cup of coffee.

pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì zhēn hǎo!
en: The weather is lovely today!

pinyin: Shì a, yìqǐ zǒuzou ba.
en: It is! Let's take a little walk together.

pinyin: Hē bēi chá zěnmeyàng?
en: How about a cup of tea?

pinyin: Hǎo a, zǒu ba!
en: Sounds good. Let's go!

zh: 林阿姨正在泡茶。你想怎么打招呼？
pinyin: Lín āyí zhèngzài pào chá. Nǐ xiǎng zěnme dǎ zhāohu?
en: Auntie Lin is making tea. How would you greet her?

zh: 你好呀！我姓林。你叫什么名字？
pinyin: Nǐ hǎo ya! Wǒ xìng Lín. Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
en: Hello there! My surname is Lin. What is your name?

zh: 欢迎你！你是来旅游的吗？
pinyin: Huānyíng nǐ! Nǐ shì lái lǚyóu de ma?
en: Welcome! Are you here on vacation?

pinyin: Mànman guàng, yǒu kòng lái hē chá!
en: Enjoy looking around. Come have tea when you have time!

pinyin: Duì, wǒ shì lái lǚyóu de.
en: Yes, I am here on vacation.

pinyin: Wǒ shì lái kàn péngyou de.
en: I am here to visit friends.

pinyin: Hǎode, xièxie!
en: Okay, thank you!

pinyin: Xièxie, zàijiàn!
en: Thank you, goodbye!

pinyin: Mǎi guo dōngxi yǐhòu zài lái.
en: Come back after buying something.

pinyin: Xiān gēn Xiǎoměi xué jǐ ge cí.
en: First learn a few words with Xiaomei.

pinyin: Tiān liàng le.
en: It has grown light.

pinyin: Wǒ qǐchuáng, hē yì bēi shuǐ.
en: I get up and drink a glass of water.

pinyin: Māma zài zuò zǎofàn.
en: Mum is making breakfast.

pinyin: Wǒ shuō: zǎoshang hǎo!
en: I say: good morning!

pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.
en: The weather is lovely today.

pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ qù gōngyuán.
en: We go to the park together.

pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de jiā.
en: This is my home.

pinyin: Jiā lǐ yǒu sān ge rén.
en: There are three people in it.

pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yì zhī xiǎo māo.
en: I have a little cat.

pinyin: Xiǎo māo xǐhuan shuìjiào.
en: The cat likes to sleep.

zh: 我的房间不大，但是很干净。
pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān bú dà, dànshì hěn gānjìng.
en: My room is not big, but it is very clean.

pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan wǒ de jiā.
en: I like my home very much.

zh: 星期六，我和朋友去超市。
pinyin: Xīngqīliù, wǒ hé péngyou qù chāoshì.
en: On Saturday I go to the supermarket with a friend.

pinyin: Wǒmen yào mǎi shuǐguǒ hé miànbāo.
en: We want to buy fruit and bread.

pinyin: Píngguǒ hěn xīnxiān, yě bú guì.
en: The apples are fresh, and not expensive either.

zh: 朋友说：再买一点鸡蛋吧。
pinyin: Péngyou shuō: zài mǎi yìdiǎn jīdàn ba.
en: My friend says: let us get some eggs as well.

pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi le hěn duō dōngxi.
en: We buy a great deal.

pinyin: Huí jiā de shíhou, xià yǔ le.
en: On the way home, it starts to rain.

pinyin: Wàimiàn xià zhe yǔ.
en: Outside, it is raining.

pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu dài sǎn.
en: I did not bring an umbrella.

zh: 一个老人给了我一把伞。
pinyin: Yí ge lǎorén gěi le wǒ yì bǎ sǎn.
en: An old man gave me one.

pinyin: Wǒ shuō xièxie, tā xiào le xiào.
en: I said thank you, and he smiled.

zh: 雨停了以后，天空很干净。
pinyin: Yǔ tíng le yǐhòu, tiānkōng hěn gānjìng.
en: After the rain stopped, the sky was very clear.

zh: 我记住了那把蓝色的伞。
pinyin: Wǒ jìzhù le nà bǎ lánsè de sǎn.
en: I have not forgotten that blue umbrella.

zh: 奶奶的箱子里有很多老照片。
pinyin: Nǎinai de xiāngzi lǐ yǒu hěn duō lǎo zhàopiàn.
en: There are many old photographs in grandmother's box.

zh: 照片上的人穿着旧衣服。
pinyin: Zhàopiàn shàng de rén chuān zhe jiù yīfu.
en: The people in them are wearing old clothes.

zh: 她指着一张说：这是你爷爷。
pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhe yì zhāng shuō: zhè shì nǐ yéye.
en: She points at one and says: this is your grandfather.

pinyin: Nà shíhou tā hái hěn niánqīng.
en: He was still very young then.

zh: 我发现奶奶的眼睛亮了起来。
pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn nǎinai de yǎnjing liàng le qǐlái.
en: I notice grandmother's eyes light up.

zh: 每一张照片后面都有一个故事。
pinyin: Měi yì zhāng zhàopiàn hòumiàn dōu yǒu yí ge gùshi.
en: Behind every photograph there is a story.

zh: 天黑以后，街上反而更热闹。
pinyin: Tiān hēi yǐhòu, jiē shàng fǎn'ér gèng rènao.
en: After dark, the street is busier rather than quieter.

zh: 摊主们把灯打开，香味到处都是。
pinyin: Tānzhǔ men bǎ dēng dǎkāi, xiāngwèi dàochù dōu shì.
en: The stallholders switch on their lights, and the smell is everywhere.

zh: 糖葫芦在灯下亮得像红色的宝石。
pinyin: Tánghúlu zài dēng xià liàng de xiàng hóngsè de bǎoshí.
en: Under the lamps the candied hawthorns shine like red stones.

zh: 我排了很久的队，才买到一串。
pinyin: Wǒ pái le hěn jiǔ de duì, cái mǎi dào yí chuàn.
en: I queue a long time before I get one.

zh: 味道又酸又甜，和小时候一样。
pinyin: Wèidào yòu suān yòu tián, hé xiǎo shíhou yíyàng.
en: It is sour and sweet at once, exactly as it was in childhood.

zh: 有些东西离开了才知道有多想念。
pinyin: Yǒuxiē dōngxi líkāi le cái zhīdào yǒu duō xiǎngniàn.
en: Some things you only miss once you have left them.
